FEAT-6-S21.title: Consent Core Logic Enforcement
FEAT-6-S21.description: Implement core business logic in ConsentService to enforce Tier 1 (de-identified storage only) and Tier 2 (identified storage allowed) rules, including conversation summarization and Safe Harbor de-identification pathways.

FEAT-6-S22.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Exposure
FEAT-6-S22.description: Expose consent workflow via FastAPI endpoints and tool_router integration, enabling the chat agent to request, record, and check consent tier during conversations.

FEAT-6-S23.title: Consent Workflow Test Coverage
FEAT-6-S23.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier enforcement, de-identification correctness, and integration with dependent services (lead capture, unknown questions).
